item.title: Lovelace nets as Under 21s draw with Cardiff City
item.description: Millwall Under 21s picked up a point in League action on Tuesday afternoon in a home draw with Cardiff City. Millwall had the first opportunity of the game, as Ra'ees Bangura-Williams found the overlapping George Beaumont, whose pinpoint cross met the head of Elias Mansor. The number 10s' subsequent header towards the bottom-left corner was well saved by Daniel Higgs. item.description: Millwall Under 21s' Assistant Manager Paul Robinson gave his take on the 1-1 draw with Cardiff City this afternoon. item.description: Millwall First-Team duo Joel Coleman and Caleb Taylor visited Lewisham College as part of Millwall Community Trust’s Post-16 Football & Education Academy. item.title: The latest loan update
item.description: Ben Drake was effective at both ends for Braintree Town last weekend. In the Essex side's 3-2 win at Truro City, Drake had initially put through his own net to make the score 2-1 to the hosts, but he then assisted Braintree's equaliser before they scored the winner five minutes into second-half stoppage-time to secure the three points.
